headword: {一方通行|いっぽうつうこう}

definitions.explanation: A road or passage that allows traffic in only one direction.
Communication or a relationship that only goes in one direction, lacking reciprocation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一方通行|いっぽうつうこう}だ。
{一方通行|いっぽうつうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逆走|ぎゃくそう}→逆走：15734_gyakusou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not drive the wrong way on a one-way street.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一方通行|いっぽうつうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many one-way streets near the station.

{一方通行|いっぽうつうこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{恋|こい}→恋：02208_koi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{辛|つら}い→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧。
⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一方通行|いっぽうつうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We take care that information flow isn't one-directional.

notes:
{一方通行|いっぽうつうこう} has both literal and figurative uses.

TRAFFIC SIGNS:
One-way streets in Japan are marked with a blue rectangular sign showing a white arrow, often accompanied by 「{一方通行|いっぽうつうこう}」 or 「⟦{進入禁止|しんにゅうきんし}→進入禁止：16530_shinnyuukinshi⟧」 (no entry) signs.

USAGE:
Used to describe communication, relationships, or information flow that lacks reciprocity or mutual exchange.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{相互|そうご}→相互：04045_sougo⟧⟦{通行|つうこう}→通行：03436_tsuukou⟧: two-way traffic/communication
